component.name: Notesy
component.summary: Desktop sticky notes with optional reminders

description.p: Keep editable notes on your desktop with individually chosen colors, sizes, and positions. Notes are saved locally in a SQLite database.
Schedule reminders using calendar-aware presets or a custom date and time. Desktop notifications are delivered while Notesy is running, with overdue reminders recovered on the next launch.

Optional playful reminder visuals (egg, bomb, toaster) add a small animation to individual notes when reminders are delivered. Expired artwork remains until cleared or rescheduled. These visuals are opt-in and do not change reminder scheduling, notification delivery or note storage.

Choose Light, high-contrast Dark or textured Paper themes. Short reminder presets, snooze controls and time-zone previews keep daily notes convenient. Optional snapping and improved window placement help organize your desktop.
